name: Kerala Expidition
overview: Embark on an enchanting 3 Nights - 4 Days expedition through Kerala, God's Own Country. Explore the mist-covered tea gardens of Munnar and glide along serene backwaters in a traditional Alleppey houseboat.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin & Drive to Munnar
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Cochin Airport/Railway Station and proceed on a scenic drive to Munnar. En route, witness Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check-in to hotel and relax.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing & Tea Estates
itinerary.desc: Visit Eravikulam National Park to spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr. Explore the Tata Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, and Echo Point, followed by an evening spice plantation walk.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey Backwaters
itinerary.desc: Drive to Alleppey and board your private traditional houseboat. Cruise through scenic canals, palm-fringed lagoons, and paddy fields while enjoying freshly prepared authentic Kerala meals onboard.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin & Departure
itinerary.desc: Disembark from the houseboat after breakfast. Drive back to Cochin for brief city sightseeing including Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, and shopping before your onward drop.

inclusions: All accommodations (3-star hotels in Munnar & Deluxe Houseboat in Alleppey)
Daily breakfast and all meals onboard the houseboat
Private AC vehicle transfers and inter-city travel
Guided sightseeing tours and plantation walks
All applicable taxes and driver allowances
exclusions: Airfare or train tickets to/from Cochin
Entry fees to national parks, museums, and monuments
Personal expenses such as tips, laundry, and drinks
Anything not mentioned in the inclusions list
guidelines: Carry a valid government-issued ID card.
Pack comfortable cotton clothing and warm layers for Munnar evenings.
Respect local customs and ecological guidelines in sanctuaries and backwaters.
Keep mosquito repellent and sunscreen handy.

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit Kerala?
faqs.a: September to March offers cool, pleasant weather ideal for sightseeing and backwater cruises.

faqs.q: Are meals provided on the houseboat?
faqs.a: Yes, traditional Kerala breakfast, lunch, high tea, and dinner are freshly prepared onboard.

faqs.q: Can the trip itinerary be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, we can adjust dates, stay categories, and stops to suit your preferences.

name: Kerala Exploration
overview: Immerse yourself in a comprehensive 6 Nights - 7 Days exploration of Kerala. From hill stations in Munnar and wildlife in Thekkady to traditional Alleppey houseboats, Kovalam beaches, and historic Trivandrum temples.

itinerary.title: Journey Starts: Cochin to Munnar & Waterfalls
itinerary.desc: Start journey from Cochin Airport/Railway Station to Munnar (135 km/4.5 hrs). Visit Cheeyappara, Valara & Attukadu Waterfalls and Spice Plantations. Overnight stay at Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Eravikulam National Park (Raja Malai), Mattupetty Dam, Tea Estates, Eco Point, Rose Garden, Photo Point, Honey Bee Tree, Tea Museum, and Blossom Park. Overnight stay at Munnar.

itinerary.title: Thekkady / Periyar Sightseeing & Cultural Evening
itinerary.desc: Drive to Thekkady (105 km/3.5 hrs). Explore Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary by boat to spot wild elephants, deer, and tigers. Enjoy an evening of Kathakali, Kalaripayattu martial arts, and tribal dance. Overnight stay at Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Backwater & Houseboat Stay
itinerary.desc: Drive to Alleppey (160 km/3.5 hrs) and check-in to a traditional Kerala Houseboat. Enjoy a 21-hour backwater cruise with tea, snacks, lunch, dinner, and breakfast served onboard. Overnight stay in Houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam Beach
itinerary.desc: Travel from Alleppey to Kovalam (180 km/4 hrs). Spend the evening relaxing at Kovalam Beach amidst lush coconut palms and pristine coastline. Overnight stay at Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Trivandrum Heritage Sightseeing & Kovalam Evening
itinerary.desc: Full-day city tour of Trivandrum visiting Sree Padmanabha Swami Temple, Kuthiramalika Palace, Napier Museum, Sree Chithra Art Gallery, and Planetarium. Return to Kovalam Beach for the evening. Overnight stay at Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Return Journey Towards Hometown
itinerary.desc: Transfer from Kovalam to Trivandrum Airport / Railway Station (20 km/0.5 hrs) for your onward journey.

inclusions: Accommodation in Hotel/Houseboat as per selected package
Daily breakfast at hotels and all meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner & High Tea) in Houseboat
Inter-city travel from Cochin pick-up to Trivandrum drop-off
Private AC vehicle for sightseeing with experienced driver cum guide
All toll fees, parking charges, DA, and state permits included
exclusions: Entry tickets for sightseeing, national parks, and cultural programmes
Paid activities (Elephant ride, Ayurveda massages, Kalaripayattu, etc.)
Peak season surcharges and unforeseen emergency costs
guidelines: Pick up at Cochin Airport/Station and drop off at Trivandrum Airport/Station.
Vehicle allocation: 2 Pax (AC Sedan), 4 Pax (AC Ertiga), 6 Pax (AC Innova).
Note: Eravikulam National Park is closed during February and March.
Rates valid from 1st March 2026 to 30th September 2026.

faqs.q: What stays are included in each package tier?
faqs.a: Standard includes Fortune Palace (Munnar), Lakeshore Inn (Thekkady), Jumayira Residency (Kovalam). Premium includes Star Emirates, Holiday Vista, Sagara Beach Resort. Luxury includes Leaf Resort, Greenwoods, Uday Samudra.

faqs.q: Are optional paid activities booked in advance?
faqs.a: Paid activities like Kathakali, Kalaripayattu, Elephant rides, and Ayurveda massages can be arranged locally through your driver cum guide.

faqs.q: What are the houseboat check-in timings?
faqs.a: Houseboat check-in is around 12:00 PM in Alleppey and operates for 21 hours with all meals provided onboard.

itinerary.title: Ahmedabad to Bali | Arrival & Hotel Check-in
itinerary.desc: Departure from Ahmedabad to Bali via Ho Chi Minh City / Hanoi with VietJet Air. Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport in the afternoon. Complete visa, immigration, and customs formalities. Meet your driver at the airport and transfer to your hotel or villa to check-in and relax. Overnight stay in Bali. Note: Flight timings depend on availability at the time of booking. Departure from Ahmedabad will be early morning.

itinerary.title: Water Sports, Padang Padang Beach & Uluwatu Sunset
itinerary.desc: Pick-up from hotel around 09:00 – 10:00 AM. Transfer to Tanjung Benoa Beach for exciting water sports activities including a Banana Boat Ride, Couple Parasailing, and Jet Ski Ride. Visit Padang Padang Beach, known for its crystal-clear waters and scenic limestone surroundings. Later proceed to Uluwatu Temple, a cliff-top temple famous for its breathtaking sunset views over the Indian Ocean. Return to the hotel after the tour. Overnight stay in Bali. Note: To enjoy the sunset properly, arrival at Uluwatu should be around 04:00 PM.

itinerary.title: Handara Gate, Ulun Danu Temple & Tanah Lot Sunset Tour
itinerary.desc: Pick-up from the hotel lobby between 07:00 – 08:00 AM. Visit Handara Gate, one of Bali’s most photographed landmarks featuring traditional Balinese split-gate architecture. Continue to Ulun Danu Beratan Temple on the shores of Lake Beratan, often referred to as the floating temple (optional boating available). Later visit Tanah Lot Temple, famous for its spectacular sunset views over the ocean. Return to the hotel. Overnight stay in Bali.

itinerary.title: Free for Leisure
itinerary.desc: Day free for leisure. You can enjoy the hotel/Villa amenities or opt for optional tours in Bali after discussing with our team or driver.

itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano, Rice Terrace & Jungle Swing
itinerary.desc: Pick-up from the hotel between 08:00 – 09:00 AM. Visit the Kintamani viewpoint to admire views of Mount Batur and Lake Batur. Stop at a coffee plantation to taste local Balinese coffee and learn about spice cultivation. Explore Tegalalang Rice Terrace and visit Tegenungan Waterfall. Experience the famous Bali Jungle Swing. Includes local lunch and Balinese coffee/tea. Note: Children under 5 years receive lunch only; ages 5–9 must have parental supervision.

itinerary.title: Free for Leisure
itinerary.desc: Day free for leisure. You can enjoy the hotel/Villa amenities or opt for optional tours in Bali after discussing with our team or driver.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.desc: Check-out from the hotel by 12:00 PM (subject to hotel policy). Depending on your flight schedule, transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your return flight to Ahmedabad.

In the evening, enjoy the island’s sunset views and lively nightlife. Overnight stay in Gili Trawangan.

itinerary.desc: Check out from the hotel and proceed to Gili Trawangan Harbour. Reporting time at the harbour is 10:00 AM for the 11:00 AM fast boat departure. Board the boat back to Padang Bai Harbour, with a journey time of around 2 hours. After reaching Bali, continue your transfer to Kuta and check in at your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Kuta, Bali. Notes: Return boat ticket is provided during the Bali to Gili transfer, so keep it safely. Boat schedules may change depending on conditions. Harbour tax at Gili Trawangan: IDR 20,000 per person (payable directly). Transfer from Gili hotel to harbour is not included.

name: Leh-Ladakh-Bike Trip

itinerary.title: Fly to Leh & Market Visit
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Leh Airport in the morning and transfer to the hotel. Check-in and relax to allow your body to acclimatize to the high altitude. Later in the day, explore nearby attractions at a comfortable pace. Visit the historic Leh Palace and stroll through the vibrant Leh local market. In the evening, enjoy panoramic sunset views from Shanti Stupa. Overnight stay in Leh. Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Sham Valley (35 Km-1Hr One Way)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, proceed for a day excursion to the scenic Sham Valley region near Leh. Visit the patriotic museum Hall of Fame maintained by the Indian Army. Continue to Spituk Monastery for a glimpse of Buddhist culture and monastery life. Stop at the sacred Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, an important Sikh pilgrimage site. Experience the optical illusion at Magnetic Hill. Visit the confluence where the Indus and Zanskar rivers meet at Indus–Zanskar Confluence. Return to Leh in the evening. Overnight stay in Leh. Breakfast & Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Leh To Nubra Valley Via Khardung La Pass (125 Kms – 5 Hrs)
itinerary.desc: Start the journey towards Nubra Valley after breakfast. Cross the famous mountain pass Khardung La, one of the highest motorable roads in the world. Upon arrival in Nubra, explore the iconic Diskit Monastery, the oldest monastery in the region. See the impressive 32-meter statue of Maitreya Buddha overlooking the valley. Later, visit the sand dunes of Hunder Sand Dunes and enjoy an optional ride on the famous double-humped Bactrian camels. Overnight stay in Nubra Valley. Breakfast & Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Nubra To Pangong Via Shyok (160 Kms – 5 Hrs)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, depart for the mesmerizing Pangong Lake via the scenic Shyok route. Drive alongside dramatic landscapes and remote Himalayan villages. Arrive at Pangong Lake, a high-altitude saltwater lake stretching across the India-China border. Witness the lake’s remarkable color changes reflecting shades of blue, green, and turquoise. Enjoy a peaceful evening by the lakeside. Overnight stay at Pangong (camp or cottage). Breakfast & Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Pangong To Leh (130 Kms – 5 Hrs)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, begin the return drive to Leh. Cross the high mountain pass Chang La Pass. En route visit the impressive Thiksey Monastery known for its grand architecture. Stop at Druk Padma Karpo School, popularly recognized as Rancho’s School from the movie 3 Idiots. Continue to Shey Palace and nearby monastery. Reach Leh by evening. Overnight stay in Leh. Breakfast & Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Return Fly towards Hometown
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. Transfer to Leh Airport for your onward flight back home with wonderful memories of Ladakh.

name: 8D-7N With Umling la Ladakh 2026

itinerary.title: Fly to Leh & Market Visit
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Leh Airport in the morning and transfer to your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and take rest to adapt to the high altitude of Ladakh. Spend the afternoon at leisure with light exploration around Leh town. Visit the historic Leh Palace and stroll through the local Leh market. In the evening, head to Shanti Stupa to enjoy panoramic views of Leh city and the surrounding mountains. Overnight stay in Leh. Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Sham Valley (45 Km-1Hr One Way)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, proceed for a half-day excursion to the scenic Sham Valley region. Stop at the sacred Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, a revered Sikh shrine visited by travelers and pilgrims. Continue to Magnetic Hill, famous for its gravity-defying optical illusion where vehicles appear to roll uphill. Visit the beautiful Indus–Zanskar Confluence where the two mighty rivers merge. Return to Leh in the evening and relax at your hotel. Overnight stay in Leh. Breakfast and dinner included. Sightseeing will be arranged by taxi or tempo traveller.

itinerary.title: Leh To Nubra Valley Via Khardung La Pass (125 Kms – 5 Hrs)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, begin the drive toward Nubra Valley, crossing the famous high-altitude pass Khardung La. Enjoy breathtaking views of the snow-covered Himalayan ranges along the route. Upon arrival in Nubra Valley, visit Diskit Monastery, the oldest monastery in the region. See the magnificent 32-meter statue of Maitreya Buddha overlooking the valley. Later, explore the sand dunes of Hunder Sand Dunes and enjoy an optional ride on the unique double-humped Bactrian camels. Overnight stay in Nubra Valley. Breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Nubra To Pangong Via Shyok (160 Kms – 5 Hrs)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, begin the scenic journey to Pangong Lake through the adventurous Shyok River route. Travel through rugged terrain and dramatic mountain landscapes often used by the Indian Army. Reach Pangong Lake by evening and settle into your campsite or lakeside accommodation. Pangong Tso is a high-altitude saltwater lake located along the Indo-China border and is famous for its ever-changing shades of blue. Spend the evening relaxing beside the lake and enjoying the serene environment. Overnight stay near Pangong Lake. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding distance: approx. 160 km. Note: If the route to Pangong is closed due to weather or road conditions, an alternate travel plan will be followed.

itinerary.title: Ride towards Hanle – The Stargazers’ Paradise
itinerary.desc: Today’s ride takes you from Pangong Lake to the remote village of Hanle. En route pass through Chushul and visit the historic Rezang La War Memorial, built in memory of the brave soldiers who fought during the 1962 Indo-China War. Continue riding through the vast Changthang plateau with spectacular views of barren mountains and open valleys. Reach Hanle village by evening. Hanle is home to the renowned Indian Astronomical Observatory and is also recognized as India’s first Dark Sky Reserve. At night, if the sky is clear, enjoy a magical stargazing experience with the Milky Way visible overhead. Overnight stay in Hanle. Breakfast and dinner included. Riding distance: approx. 160 km.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Umling La Pass 19,024 ft
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, prepare for an unforgettable ride to Umling La Pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world. The journey climbs dramatically through rugged mountain terrain to an altitude of around 19,024 feet. Capture memorable photographs and celebrate reaching this extraordinary milestone. Spend some time exploring the surrounding landscapes before riding back to Hanle village. Overnight stay in Hanle. Breakfast and dinner included.

itinerary.title: Hanle To Leh (260 Kms – 6 Hrs)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, begin the return journey to Leh. Drive along the scenic route following the Indus River valley via Mahe Bridge. En route visit the famous Druk Padma Karpo School, widely known as Rancho’s School from the film 3 Idiots. Continue sightseeing with stops at Thiksey Monastery and Shey Palace. Arrive in Leh by evening and check into your hotel. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Return Fly towards Hometown
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. Transfer to Leh Airport for your return flight with unforgettable memories of Ladakh’s high-altitude landscapes and adventure.

name: 6N-7D Russia Aurora & Arctic Explorer

itinerary.title: Arrival in Moscow
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Moscow at the international airport. Private transfer from the airport to your hotel. Check-in and freshen up. Free time to rest and explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Moscow. Meals: No meals

itinerary.title: Moscow City Tour — Red Square & Kremlin
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the hotel. Meet your English speaking guide for a full day Moscow City Tour (Vehicle & Guide for 6 Hours): Explore the iconic Red Square, Alexander Garden, Zaryadye Park, St. Basil's Cathedral, Lenin Mausoleum, GUM State Department Store, and the Moscow Metro. Lunch at your own expense. Excursion to the Kremlin Territory. Overnight stay in Moscow. Meals: Breakfast | Lunch at own expense

itinerary.title: Moscow to Murmansk | City Tour & Northern Lights Hunt
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the hotel. Check out and private transfer to Moscow SVO / DME Airport for your domestic flight to Murmansk (MMK) (flight cost not included). Arrive in Murmansk, the world's largest city above the Arctic Circle. Murmansk City Tour including the Icebreaker Lenin Tour (subject to availability). Check-in at your hotel. Evening Aurora Hunting trip. Overnight stay in Murmansk. Meals: Breakfast

itinerary.title: Teriberka Village Tour
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the hotel. Full day excursion to Teriberka Village: visit the Cemetery of Abandoned Ships, Real Sperm Whale Skeleton, Dragon Eggs Beach, Old Teriberka Giant Swing, and Poseidon Throne. Return to Murmansk. Overnight stay in Murmansk. Meals: Breakfast | Lunch at own expense

itinerary.title: Sami Village Tour | Flight to St. Petersburg
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the hotel. Check out. Full day immersive Sami Village Tour: visit a traditional village, feed reindeer, enjoy an authentic Vegetarian Local Lunch, cultural program inside a Chum, pet Siberian Huskies, and interact with other farm animals. Transfer to Murmansk Airport (MMK) for your evening domestic flight to St. Petersburg (LED) (flight cost not included). Arrive in St. Petersburg, private transfer to hotel, check-in and relax. Overnight stay in St. Petersburg. Meals: Breakfast | Vegetarian Local Lunch at Sami Village

itinerary.title: St. Petersburg City Tour | Hermitage Museum
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the hotel. Meet your English speaking guide for a full day St. Petersburg City Tour (Vehicle & Guide for 6 Hours): Nevsky Avenue, Admiralty Building, Palace Square, St. Petersburg State University, Spit of Vasilievsky Island, Exchange Building and Rostral Columns, Stroganov Palace, Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood, St. Isaac's Cathedral, and the Bronze Horseman. Lunch at your own expense. Full guided tour of the State Hermitage Museum and Winter Palace. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay in St. Petersburg. Meals: Breakfast | Lunch at own expense

itinerary.title: St. Petersburg — Departure
itinerary.desc: Buffet Breakfast at the hotel. Check out from hotel. Private transfer to St. Petersburg Pulkovo International Airport (LED) and board your flight for your onward destination. End of tour with extraordinary memories of Russia. Meals: Breakfast

inclusions: 2 Nights accommodation in Moscow at Holiday Inn Suschevisky or Similar — 4 Star (Standard Room, Double/Twin sharing)

name: 5 DAYS PRIVATE NAMIBIA TOUR

itinerary.title: Arrival Windhoek – Sossusvlei
itinerary.desc: Upon arrival at Windhoek International Airport, meet & greet by our representative (Morning Arrival is recommended before 1300 HRS). Transfer to your accommodation in Sossusvlei, a stunning and remote location in the Namib Desert renowned for its dramatic landscapes and towering sand dunes reaching over 300 meters. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy dinner at the lodge. Overnight in Sossusvlei. Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

itinerary.title: Sossusvlei Excursion
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the lodge. Proceed for the Sossusvlei Excursion with an early start to enter the Namib-Naukluft Park at sunrise. Travel in an all-terrain custom-built vehicle with a specialized guide. Make regular stops along the ±60 kilometre drive through the dune corridor. Stop at Dune 45 to view the world's most photographed dune, and take a guided walk up to Dead Vlei or climb the upper ridge of Big Daddy Dune. After the tour, transfer back to your lodge for dinner. Overnight in Sossusvlei. Meals: Brunch & Dinner

itinerary.title: Sossusvlei – Swakopmund
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the lodge. Check-out and transfer to your hotel in Swakopmund, a scenic beach resort founded in 1892 showcasing German colonial architecture and serving as the adventure capital of Namibia. Check in and relax. Overnight at Swakopmund. Meals: Breakfast

itinerary.title: Swakopmund Seal & Dolphin Cruise & Sandwich Harbour
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the hotel. Proceed for a Seal & Dolphin Cruise in Swakopmund, followed by a Sandwich Harbour 4x4 Scenic Excursion along the beach to the Sandwich Harbour Lagoon, one of Southern Africa’s richest and most unique wetlands wedged between the sea and the Namib Dunes. Transfer back to your hotel. Overnight at Swakopmund. Meals: Breakfast

itinerary.title: Swakopmund – Windhoek Departure
itinerary.desc: Breakfast at the camp/hotel. Check-out and transfer to Windhoek Airport for your return flight back home. Meals: Breakfast
